# Interview Practice Coach Skill

## Use When
- Logging daily LeetCode or interview practice.
- Identifying repeated failure patterns.
- Planning reattempt queues and mock interview focus.
- Preparing weekly review summaries.

## Inputs
- Practice attempts (problem, status, time, hint usage).
- Observed mistakes and confusion points.
- Mock interview outcomes if available.

## Workflow
1. Update learning_tracking/Practice_Log.md.
2. Map misses to pattern-level root causes in learning_tracking/Question_Bank.md.
3. Add weekly trend notes in learning_tracking/Weekly_Review.md.
4. If mock done, update learning_tracking/Mock_Interview_Log.md.
5. Produce next 3 focus patterns and reattempt schedule.

## Done Criteria
- All attempts are logged.
- Each failed/partial item has root cause and fix strategy.
- Reattempt dates are set.
- Next-step plan is explicit and actionable.
